title: Liveness rule, rerun on ALT-BROAD (decisions/0048). GATE — proposal only.
status: GATE. This artifact adopts nothing and approves nothing. The Human Lead approves in writing, in session.

rule_as_run.statement: A user-show pair is NOT LIVE if and only if BOTH: the account shows no insertion instant after that pair's tau1 = [[T0]] + W*24h, AND the pair is NOT Continued.
rule_as_run.continued: |A| >= 1 and F2 in A_H and |A_H| >= ceil(0.90*L2), A_H read at tau2 = [[T0]] + (W+H)*24h (Step 1 SS7 as amended by 0034)

conjunct_2_selects_the_two_nulls.started_and_left: |A| >= 1 and not Continued -- null ON EXIT
conjunct_2_selects_the_two_nulls.continued: the only state resting on positive evidence; the rule never reaches it

rule_as_run.insertion_instant: np.interp(play_id, stored Step 5 calibration). The curve is READ, never refitted (0029). Insertion time is not claimed watched_at (0021).
rule_as_run.anchoring: pair-level, at that pair's tau1 (0034). No user is ever dropped wholesale.
rule_as_run.tie_convention: 'after' is strict, so NOT LIVE requires max instant <= tau1; measured to be non-load-bearing, 0 ties on either population

populations.rule: EVERY FIGURE STATES ITS POPULATION (0046 SS0)

DERIV.reading: conjunct 2 narrows the population to the two nulls; conjunct 1 then does almost all of the remaining work, which is why the count moves with W at all

exclusion_set_identity_on_APPLY.reading: under ALT-BROAD the exclusion set is NOT a subset of the no-S2-record pairs, because the started-and-left component has |A| >= 1 by definition

bound_never_started.estimand: share of the position-5 population whose true state is Never started
bound_never_started.floor_attained_when: all 0 excluded never-started nulls in truth started
bound_never_started.ceiling_attained_when: all 0 excluded never-started nulls are true declines; the 99 started-and-left exclusions cannot enter either endpoint
bound_never_started.identity_note: the ceiling equals the unfiltered share because the ceiling numerator IS the unfiltered numerator on the unfiltered denominator. 0046 SS4's phrasing -- 'returning every excluded pair as a decliner reproduces the unfiltered population' -- no longer holds under ALT-BROAD: returning all 99 exclusions as decliners would give 6.272647%, which is NOT attainable, because the 99 started-and-left exclusions have |A| >= 1 observed.

bound_started_and_left.estimand: share of the position-5 population whose true state is Started and left
bound_started_and_left.floor_attained_when: all 99 excluded started-and-left nulls in truth continued
bound_started_and_left.ceiling_attained_when: all 0 excluded never-started nulls in truth started and left, and all 99 started-and-left exclusions are true exits

bound_started_and_left_COMPONENT_over_th.estimand: share of the position-5 population whose true state is Started and left, CONDITIONAL on every excluded never-started null being a true decline
bound_started_and_left_COMPONENT_over_th.WARNING: this is NOT a bound on the unconditional started-and-left share. Its ceiling does not cover the case in which an excluded never-started null in truth started and left -- the same defect 0047 SS3 records three times. Published only as the DECOMPOSITION of the lower half of bound_started_and_left, which is the operative interval.

bound_continued.estimand: share of the position-5 population whose true state is Continued
bound_continued.note: Continued is the only state that rests on positive evidence, so no exclusion can leave it; both other states can only flow INTO it

never_started_floor_with_started_and_lef.resolution: all 0 never-started nulls started and left; all 99 started-and-left exclusions are true exits

never_started_ceiling_with_started_and_l.resolution: all 0 never-started nulls are true declines; all 99 started-and-left exclusions in truth continued

joint_corner_check.reading: both corners are attainable resolutions of the same population, so the two intervals are simultaneously tight

shares_under_the_rule_on_the_FILTERED_de.note: reported because Step 8 hands Step 9 the filtered table; these are NOT the bound endpoints and must never be mixed with them

tie_convention.implemented: NOT LIVE requires max insertion instant <= tau1; 'after' strict

W_coupling_per_arm.note: D10 contains W, so the censored population differs per arm (0047 SS5). BOTH readings are given and each names itself. The mandated grid is 0027's 38/46/77/91/107/108/150/213; 60, 100, 125 and 180 are extra, and 125 and 180 are the off-grid arms 0047 SS5 quoted without their arms.

claim_1_watched_at_after_calibrated_inst.reading: a genuine record cannot be inserted before it was watched, so each of these is a place the curve reads EARLY by at least that much. The median discrepancy is the load-bearing number, not the count.

claim_2_clamped_above.claim: 5,094 records clamped above the calibration range

residual_on_the_fit_family.definition: r = interp(rid) - watched_at, in days, on checkin+scrobble records dated and <= tau_pull, where watched_at IS the insertion time
residual_on_the_fit_family.IN_SAMPLE_CAVEAT: the stored curve was fitted on exactly this family, so these residuals are in-sample and UNDERSTATE the true error; the stored held-out figures are quoted above beside them

clamp_check.note_on_that_figure: the maximum is taken over the APPLY population, i.e. AFTER D10; the line-1 table before D10 reaches 2026-11-27, which is not a tau1 the rule ever reads
clamp_check.verdict: clamping ABOVE cannot cause a false exclusion at any arm: the clamp value is later than the largest tau1 D10 permits, so every clamped account is LIVE for every pair. Instance B's stated direction is correct in principle and INERT here.

A_margin_tau1_minus_max_instant_days_EXC.reading: an excluded pair survives any residual correction smaller than its own margin; the count within a given residual is the number of exclusions that correction could reverse

A_margin_max_instant_minus_tau1_days_LIV.reading: a live pair can only flip to excluded if it is NOT Continued and the curve reads LATE by more than this margin; the residual's sign here is the opposite of the one that worries 0048 SS9

C_nonparametric_correction.definition: last_inst' = max(interp(max rid), max dated watched_at <= tau_pull)
C_nonparametric_correction.assumption: direction only: a genuine record is not inserted before it is watched, so watched_at is a lower bound on its insertion instant

excluded_set_provenance.reading: where the account's own last record is a checkin or scrobble the residual at exactly the point the rule reads is directly measurable; where it is a watch it is not, and the uniform-shift and non-parametric tests are what cover it
